verdict.rationale: Missive documents search filters for Type (Internal/External) and Date range, which now work before a term is entered. The command bar can also search all messages, contacts, or messages within a specific label. That covers basic filtered search across mail, but nothing shows the precision or speed a power user would need. Missing for 10: documented search operators/syntax, ranked or relevance-ordered results, evidence of search speed, explicit coverage of full mail history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
